key_claims.claim: Contrast-enhanced mammography cancer detection rates are lower at incidence screens than at prevalence screens in high-risk women
AI on CT angiography detects proximal large vessel occlusions with high accuracy but sensitivity drops substantially for distal M2/M3 segments
A multicenter deep learning model integrating clinical and semantic features outperformed radiologists and Bone-RADS for bone tumor malignancy stratification
Exploiting bilateral and longitudinal mammographic asymmetries improves breast cancer risk prediction over existing models
A self-supervised multimodal foundation model achieved robust performance across 31 diverse imaging datasets spanning seven modalities
